name: claude-skills
description: Battle-tested Claude Code skills: visual diff explainers, Codex reviews and delegation, resumable /goal prompts, loop design.

plugins.name: explain-diff
plugins.description: Turn a ticket, branch, or commit range into a visual HTML review explainer: background before diff, one interactive walker for the core mechanism, a literate walkthrough in execution order, a readiness verdict, and a 5-question sign-off quiz (Geoffrey Litt's speed-regulator pattern).

plugins.name: calling-codex
plugins.description: Call OpenAI Codex from Claude Code as a background job (codex exec): independent and adversarial reviews, worktree-isolated implementation tasks, hard time limits, cancel, follow-ups on the same Codex thread, and a refusal to run file-blind inside a nested sandbox.

plugins.name: goal-prompts
plugins.description: Author resumable prompts for Claude Code's /goal command: file-based progress state, transcript-checkable completion conditions, the 4000-char limit, subagent delegation, and an adversarial review gate. Includes templates and a validator script.

plugins.name: design-loop
plugins.description: Design (never run) engineered loops for long-running agent work — a loop contract (outcome + evidence, decision rights, budgets, stop policy, typed gate effects), a crash-safe ledger (lease lock, reserve-first dispatch, quarantine rule), and a tick prompt, with a validator script and a deterministic HTML pack renderer. Loop engineering as a method, not a vibe.
